domain: Arithmetic with rational numbers (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert number forms
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers as equivalent improper fractions (or as equivalent fractions with a specified denominator) to prepare for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., a b/c → (a·c+b)/c).
Rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator to enable subtraction (e.g., 3 → 15/5).
Rewriting a given fraction into an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator as a setup step when the denominator is already chosen (not the act of choosing the common denominator).
exclusion_criteria: Determining the common/least common denominator between two unlike denominators (tag S02).
Subtracting once forms are already compatible (tag S03).
Reducing/simplifying the result or converting the final answer to a different form after subtraction (tag S04).

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common (often least common) denominator for unlike fractions and rewrite each as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Explicitly finding or stating a common denominator/LCM for two denominators.
Scaling numerator and denominator to express each fraction with the same denominator (e.g., 5/6 → 15/18 and 1/9 → 2/18).
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work proceeds directly to subtraction (tag S03).
Only converting mixed/whole numbers without addressing unlike denominators (tag S01).

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracting numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b).
Subtracting by separating whole and fractional parts and combining the result (e.g., (A−B) + (a/b − c/b)).
Producing a zero result from subtracting equal quantities (x − x = 0).
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting quantities into equivalent forms or finding a common denominator (tag S01 or S02).
Only simplifying/reducing or converting the final form after subtraction is complete (tag S04).

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Reducing a fraction by a common factor (e.g., −3/12 → −1/4).
Stating/checking that a fraction is already in lowest terms.
Converting between improper fraction and mixed number (or identifying an integer/zero) for the final presentation.
exclusion_criteria: Performing the subtraction operation itself (tag S03).
Converting inputs to compatible forms before subtraction (tag S01/S02).
